Draw Cards

Cards per player

Deal 5 cards face-down to each player from the top of the shuffled deck. Players may look at their own cards but should keep them secret.

Landmarks (optional)

Special pieces placed on the map that grant unique bonuses. You may ignore or override the placement of the Tower and Ferry pieces in certain maps.

Hirelings (optional)

Minor factions that roam the woodland. Always exactly three are dealt. Players may never play a faction whose corresponding hireling is in play.

Use hirelings this game
4
Steps 1 & 2 — Dealt hirelings & demotion
Step 3 — Setup order (counterclockwise from last player)
Starting with the last player in turn order and going counterclockwise, each player sets up one hireling as described on its card.
Step 4 — Place hireling markers
Place the three hireling markers — marked "4", "8", and "12" — on the score track.
Step 5 — Return these factions to the box
A faction cannot be played if its corresponding hireling is in play. Return the faction boards, pieces, and setup cards shown below.
Enable hirelings above to use this step.

Draft Hands

After factions are chosen, players trim their hands for the game.

Keep this many cards

Each player looks at their 5 cards and discards down to 3. Discarded cards go face-up into the discard pile. You're now ready to play!
